public_observation.fixture: two FnOnce sentinels append distinct immutable tokens and increment independent in-memory counters; source inspection records callback values and causal positions without running compilation or watch

classifier.Preserved: all public predicates of the case are decidable and true
classifier.Violated: at least one public predicate is decidable and false, with the declared public witness
classifier.Unknown: the case is explicitly opaque or a required public fact is absent or ambiguous
classifier.fail_closed: Unknown is never promoted to Preserved and never rejects a mutant; any unexpected Unknown blocks seal and PASS
classifier.binding_rule: classification uses only canonical in-memory observations and frozen source facts; it does not execute a watcher or infer status from rendered text

positive_cases.predicate: status_count is exactly one and diagnostics_count is exactly one per helper invocation
status_effect and diagnostics_effect remain byte-identical to their distinct sentinel effects, with no inserted event
a fresh repeated invocation and reverse corpus traversal retain the same order, counts, classifications and witnesses
report_in_order is private and accepts status then diagnostics as FnOnce closures without a public surface change
run_compile_observed accepts one private FnMut(ExitCode,bool) observer and preserves its existing triple return shape
each preliminary input, world or source failure calls observer exactly once with ExitCode 2,false before its operational message
compiled failure without warnings orders callback(1,false), then errors exactly once
compiled failure with warnings orders callback(1,true), warnings once, then errors once
successful output is written, then requested timings are written, then callback receives SUCCESS and warnings-presence derived from collection emptiness
artifact-write failure calls callback(2,has_warnings) exactly once before warning drain and artifact operational message and never announces success
timings-write failure calls callback(2,has_warnings) exactly once before warning drain and timings operational message and never announces success
watch observer maps typed exit code and boolean warnings plus the P1365 marker elapsed to one WatchStatus and emits one P1364 block
run_watch has no terminal-status derivation or emission after run_compile_observed returns
run_compile passes a truly empty observer closure and emits no watch status
productive delta is confined to the private helper, private observer routing and causal reordering; polling and all declared scope-outs are unchanged

negative_cases.public_witness: observed sentinel effect differs from the closure-produced token

negative_cases.attack: observer callback is missing from one return path or called more than once on one path
negative_cases.public_witness: callback cardinality for a reachable return is not exactly one

negative_cases.attack: preliminary operational error is printed before callback
preliminary failure passes an exit code other than 2 or passes true warnings
compiled errors or warnings are drained before callback
negative_cases.public_witness: first compiled-result event is a drain rather than callback

negative_cases.attack: compiled failure passes SUCCESS or ExitCode 2
negative_cases.public_witness: callback typed exit differs from ExitCode 1

negative_cases.attack: errors are drained before warnings
has_warnings is fixed, parsed from diagnostic text or computed only after warnings are consumed
negative_cases.public_witness: warning_predicate_source is not the pre-drain boolean from warnings.is_empty

negative_cases.attack: success callback runs before artifact write completes
success callback runs before requested timings write completes
artifact or timings write failure announces success before or in addition to error
negative_cases.public_witness: one failing path contains SUCCESS or more than one callback

negative_cases.attack: write failure drains warnings or prints its operational error before callback Error
negative_cases.public_witness: callback(2,has_warnings) is not the first reporting event after failed write

negative_cases.attack: run_watch keeps or adds a terminal status site after observer return
watch callback uses a fresh timer, ignores typed callback arguments or calculates status from message text
negative_cases.public_witness: watch callback source is not typed exit/boolean plus returned P1365 marker elapsed

negative_cases.attack: run_compile observer is non-noop, including logging, formatting or status construction
test accesses real clock, sleep, filesystem, environment, process, watch or w
helper or observer becomes public or changes the existing public return contract
polling, dependencies, staging, publish, abandon, wait, eviction, formatter internals, other commands or another file changes

opaque_cases.reason: execution is prohibited by the memory policy

determinism_protocol.required: same classification, reason code and public witness under repetition and reverse order
determinism_protocol.state_rule: classifier is a pure function of frozen observation fields; no cache, wall clock, filesystem, process, environment or evaluation-order dependence

claim_limit: This suite specifies discrimination only for the frozen P1366 causal status-before-diagnostics fragment; it does not attest isolation or general vanila parity.
